title: Conductor develop-leg routing output (fabro-3196)
description: Replaces output_schema="routing" on the conductor develop node (fabro-017f / fabro-9ec3 arm 3 teeth pattern). Keeps the routing contract (required routing fields, preferred_next_label restricted to the develop node's four outgoing labels) and adds pass continuity: a routing that names the child run ('Develop integrated', 'Gate stuck — parked', or 'Develop child failed') FAILS validation unless context_updates.child_run_id is a non-empty string. Basis: run 01M2X6AT3V4CPSJC08SMCVB172 (2026-09-19) omitted it on the gate-stuck arm and run 01M2X6EC95G76YFNF1YTCJZG7P went unrecorded. context_updates stays otherwise open (journal, ...) exactly like the routing kind did.
